newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down 5.83 pct on poll outcome.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down 5.83 pct on poll outcome.

text.p: Thai stocks closed sharply lower on Monday as investors sold shares across the board following the New Aspiration Party's (NAP) win in Sunday's general election, brokers said.
The SET index ended 58.39 points or 5.83 percent lower at 942.34 on 9.18 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index fell 5.38 points to 72.28.
"Investors are disappointed that the Democrat Party did not win the election and form the new government," said one analyst at United Securities.
Losers outnumbered gainers 336 to to 46 with 33 issues unchanged.
The NAP won by a narrow two-seat margin over the Democrat Party in the election. The NAP on Monday announced that it would form a six-party coalition government.

Before the election, investors had pinned their hopes on a win by the Democrats because the party was seen as having a strong economic team that could bolster Thailand's slowing economy, brokers said.
